title: Network Approach to Understanding Emotion Dynamics in Relation to Childhood Trauma and Genetic Liability to Psychopathology: Replication of a Prospective Experience Sampling Analysis
limitations: - Limited set of momentary emotional states to overcome convergence problems; - Floor effects due to negative emotion items being rarely reported; - Sample may not be representative of overall population due to young, student participants; - Differences in means and variances between high CT group and other groups may have affected network comparability.
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration, but it is a replication study. Code and data availability is declared in the paper, but no specific links or repositories are provided.
